Preamble

1. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department (EMSD) was requested on 28 November 2025 to assist the Inter-departmental Fire Investigation Task Force led by the Fire Services Department (FSD) to investigate a fire incident occurred at Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po, New Territories causing multiple fatalities and injuries. Electricity Legislation Division (ELD) of the EMSD was requested to identify whether the root cause of the fire incident was electrically related.

Investigation

2. Joint site investigation under Inter-departmental Fire Investigation Task Force comprising FSD, Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF) and Government Laboratory (GL), etc was carried out by ELD’s investigation team of the following officers on 29 November 2025 and 3 December 2025.

(i) Mr. CHAN Chi-kin (Senior Electrical and Mechanical Engineer)

(ii) Mr. WONG Pui-leung (Electrical and Mechanical Engineer)

(iii) Mr. MA Chun-man (Senior Electrical Inspector)

(iv) Mr. CHOI Kin-chung (Assistant Electrical Inspector)

Information Collected

3. The following information was collected from FSD at the scene:

(i) The fire occurred at around 14:51 on 26 November 2025.

(ii) Multiple fatalities and injuries were reported.

(iii) The suspected fire origin was at the Lightwell Platform at Wang Cheong House between Flat 104 and 105 on the first floor.
